english:
Guarding for 1.25 seconds grants 'Blade Focus Ready' for 1 second. Landing a Sword swing during that window consumes it to grant 'Blade Focus' for 7 seconds.

Blade Focus grants 10% increased Sword Damage and 120% increased Sword Lunge Distance. It also increases Combat Meditation's energy gains to 5% Grenade and 10% Class Ability Energy.

Guarding or stowing the Sword removes Blade Focus.

source.text:
4 Piece | Blade Focus

Upon guarding for 1.25 seconds:
Grants Blade Focus Ready for 1 second.
 Swinging while it is active AND scoring a hit consumes Blade Focus Ready to grant Blade Focus for 7 seconds.

Blade Focus:
10% Increased Sword Damage and 120% Increased Sword Lunge Distance
Combat Meditation Energy Gains are increased to 5% Grenade and 10% Class Ability Energy.
Blade Focus is removed upon guarding or stowing the sword.
